name: dsh-tool-unoutloud
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: detects when the agent writes a tool call (or raw XML) as plain user-visible chat text by mistake, nudges the agent ('was that a mistake?'), and offers a low-token retry_stray_call tool when the call is parseable — with explicit feedback when it is not.

scripts.test: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build.mjs && node --test test/detect.test.mjs test/integration.test.mjs test/dist.test.mjs
